Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding kickoff — NorthForge packet attached

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this on. I manage vendor operations at NorthForge — we’re excited to get set up as a Redwood supplier so engineering services can be onboarded next quarter. Per our call earlier, I’ve attached our standard vendor packet (PDF) and a signed W9. Quick overview of what we’re aiming for:

- Payment terms: Net 30 (open to discussion)
- Tax & legal: W9 attached
- Bank details: will include in PO flow (see attached PO template)

Can you confirm the Redwood procurement checklist so we can prepare anything else up front? Also looping in our Legal contact if needed — Jordan Wells (that’s me).

Best,
Jordan Wells
Vendor Operations
NorthForge, Inc.
jwells@northforge.io

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Wells <jwells@northforge.io>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding kickoff — NorthForge packet attached

Jordan — thanks for the packet and the W9, received. Welcome — we’re looking forward to working with NorthForge. I’m our procurement lead for new suppliers and I’ll own the intake checklist. Quick summary of what we need from you to finish onboarding on our side:

1) Completed supplier intake form (I attached our fillable PDF below)
2) Remit/banking details (ACH preferred) — sample PO already helps, but we need a signed bank authorization form or voided check
3) Certificate of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood Inference as a certificate holder (see COI notes on page 2 of our intake form)
4) Contact for invoicing and escalation (name, email, phone)
5) If you will be storing any customer data while delivering services, please complete the short security questionnaire (we’ll send separately)

On our side here’s what you can expect from Redwood within 7 business days after we receive the completed items above:
- We will create a vendor record and return a vendor ID
- Procurement will issue a Purchase Order once payment terms are finalized and the vendor record is active
- Marcus (cc’d) will validate billing details and set up routing for invoices
- Monica (cc’d) will run a quick compliance check and confirm whether a SOC2 questionnaire is needed

Next steps: Jordan, please fill the attached "Redwood Supplier Intake Form.pdf" and return with the COI and banking proof. If Net 30 is a hard requirement please note that in your reply and Marcus will flag it for the finance team.

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Intake_Form.pdf (fillable)

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Direct: +1 (646) 555-0124

Jordan — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Confirming receipt of: PO_template_NorthForge.xlsx, COI_NorthForge.pdf, BankAuth_NorthForge.pdf.

Answers to your questions:
- Invoices (PDF) should be sent to ap-invoices@redwood.ai. We also support EDI for high-volume partners — Marcus can follow up if you’d like that route.
- For remittance exceptions, please contact ap-ops@redwood.ai; Marcus will be the internal owner for the exception until your vendor record is fully active.

Next actions (mutual action plan):
1) Marcus to validate bank auth & set up vendor record (ETA 2 business days)
2) Monica to complete compliance quick-check (SOC2/questionnaire decision) (ETA 3 business days)
3) Procurement to issue PO upon vendor activation and agreed payment terms (ETA 5 business days)
4) Jordan to upload any missing paperwork to the shared onboarding doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-NF-onboarding-checklist (I’ll send Drive invite)

We’re targeting PO issuance by 2028-04-09 assuming no gaps. If Net 30 vs Net 45 needs a stakeholder sign-off, flag now and we’ll accelerate.

Thanks again — welcome aboard.

—
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
